sources.title: Shane Legg (DeepMind Founder) — 2028 AGI, superhuman alignment, new architectures
sources.quote_checked: When I say AGI, I mean a machine that can do the sorts of cognitive things that people can typically do, possibly more. | if you can't find it with some effort, then for all practical purposes, you have an AGI. | I would want a whole suite of tests that I felt was very comprehensive. | I think it'll be architectural in nature because the current architectures don't really have what you need to do this. | I don't think it's a fundamental limitation. | trying to somehow contain it or limit it is probably not a winning strategy. | You have to get it such that it's fundamentally a highly ethical value aligned system from the get go. | I think it's actually more robust to check the process of reasoning and check its understanding of ethics. | I think there's a 50% chance that we have AGI by 2028. | At the moment, it looks to me like all the problems are likely solvable with a number of years of research. | I find it very hard to reason about the counterfactuals there.

sources.quote_checked: I think we're getting very close and will probably reach this next year or the year after | We decided to start DeepMind in 2010 | Times of disruption are also times of opportunity.
